comparison.objective: Orient and feed a laminating pouch sealed-edge first, then release it to rollers; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests thin-object orientation, square slot feeding, and release timing. Candidate tests precision tool engagement, screw/collar manipulation, socket reacquisition, and response-based tuning.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires a square sealed-edge bite and complete feed without an open-edge or held-pouch jam. Candidate requires two consecutive bounded mechanical impacts without bottoming, overload, rebound, or drift.
comparison.reason: Feed orientation and roller handoff do not test adjustment, locking, or dynamic energy absorption.
